title: Technical Associate - .NET Fullstack
jobDescription:
Location Home View All Jobs Jobs View Profile Search by Keyword Search by Location Show More Options Loading... Skill All Posting Country All Select how often (in days) to receive an alert: Create Alert × Select how often (in days) to receive an alert: Technical Associate
- .NET Fullstack Apply now » Date: Jul 21, 2026 Location: Hyderabad, India Company: Evoke Technologies Private Limited Job Summary The Technical Associate under direct supervision of the Technical Lead / Project Manager is responsible for developing, implementing and supporting individual components within an application. This involves analysis, developing/coding, testing and implementation of the components. This may also involve providing enhancements and ongoing application support to the deployed application. Experience Location: Hyderabad Work Mode : Hybrid (3 days/week) Experience: 1 to 4Yrs Employment Type: Full-time Job Requirement: Experience as a Full Stack Developer. Extensive experience with the latest versions of the Angular framework. Strong proficiency in front-end technologies, including HTML, CSS, and Java Script. In-depth knowledge of back-end programming languages such as Node.js, Python, .NET. Experience with various database technologies, including My SQL, Mongo DB. Proficiency in designing and integrating RESTful APIs. Experience with version control systems, particularly Git. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills Proven experience working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Git Hub Copilot, Gemini) to improve code quality and productivity. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain both front-end and back-end architecture for our web applications. Create and manage databases and server-side applications. Develop and implement effective and scalable APIs. Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code, adhering to best practices and utilizing AI-assisted development tools. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Ensure the responsiveness and cross-platform compatibility of applications, with a focus on mobile optimization. Stay current with emerging AI trends and technologies and actively explore opportunities to incorporate them into our products and development workflows. Conduct thorough testing and debugging to ensure software quality and performance. Competencies Requirements Gathering Application Maintenance C# .NET Microsoft

- Asp.Net Microsoft .Net Microsoft ASP.Net C# Microsoft
